Technology profile

Version 3.1, core. The NSF abstract names 3 technologies of this Engine (scientific and technical fragments extracted with a fixed prompt; the extraction was done by hand in a chat session, not reproducible). For each technology, all 4,516 OpenAlex topics and all CPC main groups are ranked by several independent signals; the core keeps up to 2 topics and 2 CPC main groups per technology. Judge: chosen by a rubric judge where no candidate was confirmed by two kinds of evidence (also by hand in a chat session). An empty cell: no suitable item among the candidates. See Methodology and the comparison of versions.

Data and limitations

  • People: PIs and Co-PIs from the NSF Award API; leadership listed on the Engine’s website. Roles come from titles and organisations, revised with OpenAlex evidence.
  • Partners: as listed on the Engine’s website, plus organisations of team members. Some Engines publish partner logos without names.
  • Region: the Engine’s counties where the list is known (NEO-SMART: 18 Northeast Ohio counties; STELLAR: 11 counties from the NSF abstract), otherwise its states (state-level proxy).
  • Technology profile: v3.1 (switch versions in the header). Partner papers and regional patents depend on it: v1 uses mostly CPC subclasses, the v3.1 core uses CPC main groups, which are narrower, so it counts fewer patents and the LQ of a small region rests on few patents.
  • Papers: OpenAlex; partner papers are restricted to the Engine’s OpenAlex topics.
  • Patents: USPTO grants 2021-2025; inventor locations from PatentsView; pre-grant publications are not included.
